meta.purpose: R3-M1/R5: adjudicate the CL1 regime divergence (frozen gR reversal vs DREEAM Table 6 retrained preservation)

protocol.train: Re-DocRED train_revised, PE8-aligned exclusion (2748/3053 docs; the 305 calibration-shard docs removed, titles matched to train_annotated_pe8.json)
protocol.dev: Re-DocRED dev_revised (498 docs = the audit evaluation set itself)
protocol.atlop_code: data/atlop_repo (official; patched for transformers 5.x, eager attention)
protocol.dreeam_code: official YoumiMa-dreeam-476a700 (bundle tarball; same patch set + meta/rel2id + Windows colon-safe paths)
protocol.metric: dev relational micro-F1 (best over epochs, per seed)
protocol.encoder: bert-base-uncased for both arms (identical conditions); literature Table-6 entries use RoBERTa-large, so cross-table comparisons are directional only

pooled_doc_paired_bootstrap.basis: per-doc triple counts (tp/fp/fn) from best-checkpoint inference on the 498-doc revised dev; seed-averaged per-doc counts; document-paired

inference_f1_anchors.note: inference micro-F1 reproduces each run's best dev F1 to 4 decimals

reference_dreeam_table6.encoders: RoBERTa-large (literature); our E-A24 arms are BERT-base

adjudication.artifact_hypothesis: not supported: the pooled document-paired bootstrap margin is +0.48 points with 95% CI [+0.07, +0.88], excluding zero, though one of the three seed-aligned pairs is slightly negative (-0.10); the direction matches the literature test-set margin (+0.38). Earlier circulation of this file listed the DREEAM per-seed values in a non-seed order, which made the per-seed margins appear all-positive; corrected here (2026-11-22).
adjudication.regime_divergence: CONFIRMED as a genuine finding: a retrained comparison rebuilds the pipeline under the new gold and cannot show which published near-ties are gold-fragile at prediction level; the frozen audit measures exactly this
adjudication.protocol_robustness: quick-retrain absolute F1 (73.5-74.0) sits 4 points under the literature full protocol (77.5-78.3) without changing the margin direction
adjudication.wording_standard: manuscript may claim: preserved with CI, positive in two of three seed pairs; not 'rejected' as a categorical verdict
